_note: One entry per released version, newest last. free[] and pro[] are plain lines that every user sees (Free users see the Pro list too, it is public marketing copy like the pricing page). Plain benefit wording only: no engine, trick or recipe names. Anything internal belongs in the Pro pack's own whats_new_pro.json. A line is a string, or {"text": "...", "media": "/webapp/docs/..png"}. The release gate fails when the entry for VERSION is missing. Optional per version: "date" (YYYY-MM-DD) and "hero", the big visual at the top of the card and the website changelog: {"kind": "vertical", "title", "original", "free", "pro"} (each {"video", "poster"}) or {"kind": "media", "video" or "image", "poster", "caption"}. "showcase" holds the standing "What Pro adds" items (measured, never projected) shown to Free users under New in Pro. Media goes in assets/whats_new/ (served at /assets/whats_new/; the website copies it with its sync script). Per version "how": [{"id", "title", "free": {"video", "poster", "caption"}, "pro": {...}}], a few seconds of the real Studio showing where the button is and what you get; every new feature gets one, and the feature links to it by id.

pro.text: Pro makes 5-second H3 clips faster: 14:57 on Free, 10:02 on Pro, the same clip on the same Mac. 10 and 15-second H3 clips render at Free speed for now.

free: Pictures work on a fresh Mac app install. If the picture engine is missing, Phosphene adds it by itself, once.
A missing text-model file is named before a video starts, not after it fails.
Songs wait for memory on Macs with 24 GB or less, and say so, instead of failing partway.

pro: Your Pro licence stays on your Mac when you delete and reinstall Phosphene. No pasting your key again.
Lost your key? "Already paid? Restore Pro" emails it to you again.

free: Hailuo H3 now runs on 16 GB and 18 GB Macs. It needed 36 GB before. Free for everyone.
The version is easier to see. When an update is ready, look for the coloured Update to button.
See what changed after each update. Click the version to read it again.
In Mac app 5.0.8, Check for updates checks the app, Studio and Pro together.
pro: In Mac app 5.0.8, Pro checks for updates every 10 minutes while the app is open. It waits until your render finishes before switching.

free: Hailuo H3 clips now all play at the same loudness, whichever speed you pick.
Resuming a music download reuses engine code already on your Mac and keeps the model files already downloaded.
Mac app: download Hailuo H3 right inside Phosphene. Click Hailuo H3 in the engine switcher. If you quit halfway, it carries on where it stopped.
Music setup in the Mac app no longer needs Apple developer tools.
The Mac app keeps installed Speech and Music engines across updates, remembers your video generation choice, and waits for installs and downloads before updating.
Connect your agent from Help → Connect an agent in the Mac app.
pro: Clips from Pro's faster H3 lane now have full-volume sound.
Installing Speech and switching video generations no longer break the next Pro startup check.

free: Shot setup opens by default, with quieter prompt guidance and fewer distractions.
Orientation controls stay compact and aligned.
The Editor timeline stays clear of render progress panels, including in narrow windows.
Finished clips stay in preview until you return to the render or start another take.
Stop cancels the current render promptly.
Completion sounds no longer repeat when the history refreshes, and the visible Studio stays quiet.
Installed video models stay selectable when returning from Images.
Cleaner shot controls, with detailed explanations in Docs.
Timeline clips show a frame again in the Mac app, and say where they sit in the film.
Changing or removing the soundtrack now sticks in preview, render, save and export.
Drop pictures and clips onto the overlay lane; render progress and Cancel stay on screen.
Dragging a clip shows what it will do: move, reorder, ripple, slip, roll or trim.
Queued clips keep going while one engine updates, and the queue says what it is waiting for.
Plain messages when the video model is not downloaded yet, and when the engine restarts itself.
In the Mac app, the update notice says what is updating and when it is done.
Mac app wording now matches the app: no Pinokio instructions, and the right models folder.
New picture model: MiniMax-H3-Image, free for everyone. Text to image at 4, 8 or 16 megapixels. Preview.
It needs a Mac with 48 GB of memory or more, and downloads once the first time you use it.
Make it vertical: a tall 9:16, 4:5 or square copy of any clip, with a soft blurred fill. In the More menu on any clip.
Timeline clips show a picture right away, before Prepare.
pro: Make it vertical (AI fill): real picture above and below, as if the clip was shot tall. For Macs with 48 GB or more.

hero.title: Make it vertical
hero.caption: The same clip, three ways. Free keeps the whole picture with a soft blurred fill. Pro paints real picture above and below.

free.label: Free: blurred fill
free.caption: Open More on a finished clip and pick Make it vertical. A tall copy with a soft blurred fill appears next to it in seconds.

pro.label: Pro: AI fill
pro.caption: Pick Make it vertical (AI fill) in the same menu. AI paints real picture above and below. About 15 minutes for a 5-second clip, on Macs with 48 GB or more.

free: A bigger What's new, with clips of what changed. Click the version number to see it again.
How Make it vertical works: a short clip shows where to click. In the More menu on any clip.
Clearer messages when a character training or a Control render cannot start: they name the photo or the download and say what to do.
A character training keeps going when you rename its trigger word after the captions are written.
pro: Your Pro: click the Pro badge next to the logo to see everything your licence turns on in this version, and where to find it.
Every Pro feature is marked where you use it, so you can see what is on with your licence.

free.label: Free: blurred fill
free.caption: Open More on a finished clip and pick Make it vertical. A tall copy with a soft blurred fill appears next to it in seconds.

pro.label: Pro: AI fill
pro.caption: Pick Make it vertical (AI fill) in the same menu. AI paints real picture above and below. About 15 minutes for a 5-second clip, on Macs with 48 GB or more.

pro: Faster LTX clips: about a quarter less waiting on a 5-second LTX-2.5 clip, on by default on Macs with 32 GB or more. Untick Pro speed-up beside Quality to render a clip the usual way.

free.label: Free
free.caption: Pro adds about a quarter less waiting on LTX clips, on Macs with 32 GB or more.

pro.label: Pro
pro.caption: On by default beside Quality. Same clip, same seed: 152 s on Free, 113 s with Pro (M4 Max 64 GB).

free: MiniMax-H3-Image now edits your pictures. Drop a photo into Picture 1 in Images and say what to change; the result keeps the photo's shape.
Combine up to 6 pictures in one edit: name them in the prompt, like the hat from Picture 2 on the person in Picture 1.
Change the shape while editing: pick another shape and the model fills the new area, for example a tall poster made wide.
Edit this picture: in the More menu on any finished picture. It opens the picture in Images, so you can keep changing it.
Two more shapes for pictures: 3:2 and 2:3.
Fixed: the Upscale & Face Fix add-on no longer says it needs Q8 when Q8 is installed.
Phosphene Remote 0.4 is out for iPhone: every Studio workflow from your phone. Update it in the App Store.

free.label: Edit one picture
free.caption: Images, MiniMax-H3-Image: drop a photo into Picture 1 and say what to change. One picture at Draft took about 5 minutes on an M4 Max 64 GB.

free.label: Combine pictures
free.caption: Add a second picture and name it in the prompt. Two pictures at Draft took about 8 minutes on an M4 Max 64 GB.
